item.title: Dashavatar and Mahavatar
item.description:
Kedi: “The secret—what is Kumbh?”

Ganesh: “When a new human mind from Vaikuntha enters an existing human body on Earth, that descent process is called Kumbh.”

Kedi: “New human mind, human body, descent process—I didn’t understand anything.”

Ganesh: “The mind of every human being on Earth is created in Vaikuntha; for the development of that human mind, it is sent to Earth. The human body is created on Earth, but the mind is not created in that body; the mind has to enter that body—this is called the descent process.”

item.title: 21 Forms of Parmeshwari
item.description:
Parmeshwari Gauri: Riddhi and Siddhi

Since the Parmeshwar Uchchishta Ganapati is the male aspect, the Parmeshwar Uchchishta Ganapati did not need to take different forms to create different subjects; hence, the Parmeshwar Uchchishta Ganapati did not take any other form that was identical to himself for the creation of the universe.

Since the Goddess Gauri is the female aspect, the Goddess Gauri had to take different forms that were identical to herself to provide completion and expansion to different subjects; hence, the Goddess Gauri first divided herself into Riddhi and Siddhi forms to provide completion and expansion to the universe.

item.title: 33 Koti Devi Devta
item.description:
Introduction to the 33 Koti Devas

Kedi: “On this journey, I had darshan of Lord Vitthal, Goddess Tulja Bhavani, Shivling, Lord Vishnu, and Lord Ganapati—five gods in total. How many gods are there altogether?”

Ganesh: “The Supreme God has 33 forms, which are called the 33 Koti Devas.”

Kedi: “Does 33 Koti mean 33 crore gods?”

Ganesh: “No, 33 Koti means 33 types. Just as categories are referred to as higher koti or lower koti for classification, similarly, the forms of the Supreme God are referred to as 33 Koti instead of 33 types.”

item.title: Prophecies of Bhagwan Kalki
item.description:
Before incarnating God upon the Earth, the Supreme Lord Adi Ganapati, through Lord Vishnu, causes awareness and prophecy of the Lord’s arrival. In prophecy, instead of using the actual names of any person, place, or event, symbolic and synonymous words are chosen, so that no wicked person may misuse the details of the prophecy to mislead the world.

1. Birth-Place

According to the prophecy, Lord Kalki will be born on Shambhal Island. The Gandharva city situated on the seashore is called Shambhal Island. Gandharva city is called Film City. At present in India, Mumbai, Kannur, Chennai, and Visakhapatnam, etc., are Shambhal Islands. Lord Kalki will be born in one of these cities in India—Mumbai, Kannur, Chennai, Visakhapatnam, etc.
